scope: Ground replacement shortlist eligibility before the existing 32-entry cap.
finding: Excluded groups, convoy assets and disabled vehicle/gunnery features could consume the shortlist before the executor rejected them, hiding a later eligible replacement.
implementation: Apply the existing live fallback eligibility predicates before shortlist truncation. The executor still rechecks authority, current eligibility, communications, reservation and weapon suitability.
limits: Other later executor rejections can still crowd the shortlist. Additional eligibility checks have no measured frame-time result. Physical support dispatch, normal/HC behaviour and the performance budget remain unverified. Audits paused; whole production goal incomplete. No percentage increase.
